name: The Sky Project: Land of Noris
description:
About This Game

Embark on a hand-drawn adventure shaped by mystery and loss that will challenge everything you’ve ever known!

The Sky Project: Land of Noris is a monster collector set in a vast, vertical world, with strategic 3vs3 battles and permanent death mechanics.

Mana gives shape to unique creatures that you can establish magical contracts with: The Noris.

There are over 200 of them across 6 different types, including legendary and alternate-color Noris hidden throughout the world. The moment you forge a pact with a Nori, your adventure together truly begins. Choose one of the three starters, raise it, protect it, and help it reach its full potential!

As your bond grows stronger, you’ll be able to customize your Noris and they will evolve into even more powerful forms, transforming their appearance, permanently increasing their stats, and learning devastating new abilities. Every evolution will also strengthen the bond you share, giving you the power to overcome even greater challenges on your adventure!

Fight in strategic 3v3 multi-turn battles where your Noris face the risk of permanent death.

Every Nori is born with 2 unique abilities, plus a random third skill that changes every turn, allowing for unexpected combos and constantly evolving combat opportunities. There are more than 300 abilities to discover tied with different Noris, as well as powerful relics and altered states capable of creating devastating combinations.

Combine the types of your Noris, combos and abilities to create different strategies and powerful team synergies. Plan your turns carefully because your entire team shares the same mana pool, so every tactical decision will be meaningful and resource management will be just as important as raw power. Remember: if your Nori’s health reaches 0, you will lose it forever! The only thing left will be to mourn it and visit its grave.

Prepare for challenging battles and face five major bosses and powerful ancient beings during your journey. 

Discover an interconnected world formed by four planes, Celestia, Noreth, The Depths and Infernia.

Stacked on top of each other, they are filled with cities, villages, giant metropolises and dangerous dungeons. Face ancient beings, descend through the scars left by forgotten wars and piece together more than 2,000 years of broken history between the planes.

Every plane is inhabited by unique characters, each with their own lives, professions, ambitions, and struggles. Many of them are part of different groups or factions with shared goals, and as you progress through the game, you may have the opportunity to join some of these organizations.

Exploring comes with its own risks and rewards in a world where everything revolves around a system of trade, relics and dungeons. Relics are hard to find but a true treasure: unique magical artifacts that you can equip and grant you powerful passive effects that transform the way your Noris fight and the way you interact with the world. There are over 40 waiting for you to find them!

In The Sky Project: Land of Noris, every environment, creature and city is designed to tell its own story through atmosphere, visual storytelling and exploration, turning the world itself into a silent narrator throughout your journey.

 

Your adventure will start in Celestia, where every Celestial has a soulbonded mate, another being they’re eternally linked to through their life force since the moment they are born.

Play as Kael, a Celestial that has been Soulbonded to Aeris for hundreds of years, living in peace and harmony without ever knowing uncertainty, fear or pain. However, when Aeris disappears, Kael’s life gets turned upside down. The determination to find Aeris again becomes the driving force behind every step, and the catalyst to forge the first pact with a Nori and start a journey beyond the confines of Celestia.

  • Embark on an adventure shaped by mystery and loss, where every element and character becomes the narrator through beautifully crafted hand-drawn art.

  • Forge contracts with over 200 Noris that you can customize through level-up choices, evolutions and more than 300 abilities, and create powerful synergies and evolving combat combinations.

  • Fight in strategic 3v3 battles with permadeath mechanics where every tactical decision matters.

  • Explore four massive planes filled with cities, villages, giant metropolises and dangerous dungeons. Meet more than 250 NPCs across a world shaped by over 2,000 years of history.

  • Face five major bosses and powerful ancient beings during your journey, and encounter legendary Noris and rare alternate-color Noris hidden throughout the world.

  • Collect consumables, capture scrolls and other useful items as well as relics capable of completely changing your combat strategy.
short_desc: Hand-drawn monster collector where every creature lost might be gone forever. Explore four unique planes and train 200+ mana creatures.
